Definition: from G2687; a deposit, i.e. (specially) costume:--apparel.
BiblicalUsage: Women are to adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety, not with broided hair or gold or pearls or costly array.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe modesty is not about hiding beauty but about wearing the kind that lasts.
